name: Notification Delivery Report
query:
SELECT
    DATE(creation) AS `Data`,
    user AS `Usuario`,
    status AS `Status`,
    COUNT(*) AS `Quantidade`
FROM `tabFCM Notification Log`
WHERE DATE(creation) >= %(from_date)s
  AND DATE(creation) <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY DATE(creation), user, status
ORDER BY `Data` DESC, user;
